title: Decision of the AI Office
summary: The AI Office has issued a decision outlining its approach to managing and regulating artificial intelligence. The document sets out the key principles, responsibilities, and implications for stakeholders involved in AI development and deployment.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Technology Specialists in AI
summary: The AI Office Vacancy policy outlines the company's initiative to hire and onboard new Technology Specialists in AI to support its evolving AI projects. It details the qualifications, responsibilities, and recruitment process for these roles, ensuring that the organization builds a skilled team to drive AI innovation.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Lead Scientific Adviser
summary: The policy document announces a vacancy for a Lead Scientific Adviser in the AI office, outlining the role’s key responsibilities and required qualifications. It sets expectations for scientific oversight, ethical AI guidance, and collaboration across departments.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Legal Officers
summary: This policy outlines the responsibilities and qualifications for legal officers in the AI office, ensuring they oversee compliance with applicable laws and regulations. It also provides guidance on managing AI-related legal risks and supporting ethical deployment across the organization.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Policy Officers
summary: The policy explains how vacancies in AI-related offices are identified and filled by designated policy officers. It outlines the responsibilities of those officers in ensuring qualified candidates are selected through a transparent, compliant hiring process.

title: AI Act Scientific Panel
summary: The AI Act Scientific Panel is a group set up to evaluate and advise on the regulatory framework for AI technologies. It reviews scientific evidence and best practices to ensure the Act is informed by technical expertise.

title: Draft Standardisation Request
summary: The document is a draft request urging the creation of standardized guidelines for AI systems, emphasizing the need for uniform rules across the industry. It highlights the importance of clear, shared norms to promote safety, transparency, and accountability in AI development and deployment.

title: CoP Consultation Notice
summary: This notice announces a consultation to gather input for establishing a Community of Practice (CoP). It invites stakeholders to share their perspectives on the CoP’s goals, structure, and governance.

title: CoP Call for Expression of Interest
summary: The document is a call inviting individuals or organizations to express interest in joining a new Community of Practice (CoP). It outlines the purpose of the CoP, the benefits of participating, and the steps and deadline for submitting an expression of interest.

title: CoP Graphic: Overview of Iterative Drafting Process
summary: This policy document gives a clear visual overview of the iterative drafting process used by a community of practice (CoP). It outlines the main stages, feedback loops, and collaborative techniques that guide the creation and refinement of AI policy drafts.

title: CoP Graphic: Timeline of Drafting Process
summary: This document shows a visual timeline of the drafting process for the Community of Practice (CoP) policy. It outlines the key milestones and dates that guided the development of the policy.

title: Code of Practice: 1st Draft
summary: The Code of Practice: 1st Draft provides an initial set of guidelines for the responsible use of artificial intelligence, emphasizing ethical considerations, transparency, and accountability. It serves as a foundational framework intended for organizations to adopt best practices and align with evolving AI regulations.

title: Code of Practice: 2nd Draft
summary: This document proposes a set of guidelines for responsible AI development and deployment, aiming to promote transparency, fairness, and accountability. It outlines recommended practices for organizations to ensure AI systems are safe, ethical, and aligned with societal values.

title: Code of Practice: 3rd Draft
summary: This document presents the third draft of a set of guidelines for responsible AI development and use. It outlines principles and standards intended to help organizations implement ethical, safe, and transparent AI practices.

title: AI Pact Draft
summary: The AI Pact Draft outlines a collaborative agreement for responsible AI development and usage. It aims to set principles, standards, and shared commitments among stakeholders to promote safety, fairness, and transparency in AI technologies.

title: AI Pact Final
summary: The AI Pact Final is a comprehensive agreement that outlines responsibilities, standards, and governance principles for AI development and deployment. It sets out collaborative commitments from stakeholders to ensure AI is used responsibly, transparently, and equitably.

title: Guidelines on prohibited artificial intelligence (AI) practices
summary: The document lists AI behaviors and applications that are prohibited. It explains why those practices are forbidden and provides examples of what should not be done.

title: Guidelines on AI System Definition
summary: This policy clarifies what qualifies as an AI system for regulatory purposes. It outlines criteria such as the use of machine learning models, data processing, and decision‑making capabilities.

title: Communication on Boosting Start-Ups & Innovation
summary: This policy outlines how to effectively communicate strategies to support and grow start-up businesses while fostering innovation. It focuses on outreach, collaboration, and resource allocation to accelerate new ventures.

title: EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups
summary: The EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups is a European program that offers high-performance computing resources, training, and support to early-stage companies. It helps startups accelerate research, development, and innovation by giving them access to advanced HPC infrastructure and expertise.

summary: This AI policy document introduces a webinar presentation on risk management. It covers key concepts, identifies common risks, and outlines strategies for assessing and mitigating those risks.
